pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions on the mid-to-lower flank exhibit sharp pixel gradients and jagged, star-shaped geometry with high relative spatial area. Regions on the upper neck are obscured by raised, nodular textures.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous topological graph across the flank and lower neck, characterized by distinct tri-point and tetra-point junction nodes and a narrow, consistent pixel thickness.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Significant textural disruption is visible on the upper neck and dorsal ridge, appearing as a dense cluster of raised, dark-brown, bulbous nodular masses that alter the dorsal silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark avian organisms (oxpeckers) clinging to the hide on the flank and neck regions.
